question: 2022 Winter Olympics is scheduled to be held in the city of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Beijing**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The **2022 Winter Olympics** is scheduled to be held in the city of **Beijing**.
 
• Beijing will make history as the first city to host both the Summer (2008) and Winter (2022) Olympic Games.
 
• The decision was made by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) during the 128th IOC Session in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, on July 31, 2015.
 
• The event will feature 109 events across 15 disciplines in 7 sports.
 
• Beijing's hosting of the Winter Olympics is expected to further promote winter sports in China and across Asia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__ ** 

 
• The Winter Olympics is a major international sporting event held once every four years for sports practiced on snow and ice.
 
• The first Winter Olympics was held in Chamonix, France, in 1924.
 
• The 2022 Winter Olympics will run from February 4 to February 20, 2022.
 
• Beijing's iconic National Stadium, also known as the Bird's Nest, will host the opening and closing ceremonies.
 
• The main competition zones will be in central Beijing, Yanqing, and Zhangjiakou.
